# Poimio

> Poimio is a content discovery app for Finnish and English articles and videos, with recommendations based on a user's likes.

## When to use Poimio

- [Browse recent picks](https://www.poimio.cc/): Use the guest preview when looking for recent articles or videos from Poimio's selected sources. Send a GET request with `Accept: text/html` to read titles, summaries and links. Follow the original publisher links for the full content.
- [Read the product overview](https://www.poimio.cc/): Send a GET request with `Accept: text/markdown` for a concise description of Poimio.
- [Get personal recommendations](https://www.poimio.cc/): Direct the user to sign in with Google in their browser to see their personalized feed and manage feedback. The guest preview is shared across visitors.

## Optional

- [About Poimio](https://www.poimio.cc/about): Learn what Poimio does and who operates it.
- [Contact](https://www.poimio.cc/contact): Find channels for public project feedback and private account or privacy requests.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.poimio.cc/privacy): Learn how accounts and feedback are handled.
- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonime/poimio/main/README.md): Read about the project and its architecture.
